moves.label: Quick Cyborg Jab
moves.description: Fast high jab with a short active window from Franky's compact mechanical fist.

moves.label: Low Weapons Left
moves.description: Quick low cyborg strike with long active coverage as Franky drops and drives forward.

moves.label: Strong Right Hook
moves.description: Quick mid hook with a brief active window that swings Franky's heavy right arm.

moves.label: Cyborg Wheel Kick
moves.description: Quick mid wheel kick with long active frames as Franky rolls his body through the target.

cmd:qcf+4.label: Franky Cannon Laser
cmd:qcf+4.description: Charge Franky's arm cannon from a quarter-circle stance, then release a full-screen laser.

cmd:O+2.label: Franky Radical Laser
cmd:O+2.description: Aim Franky's weapon arms, charge, then fire a launching full-screen mechanical laser.

cmd:O+1.label: Franky Coup de Burst
cmd:O+1.description: Charge Franky's forward cannon stance, then release a launching full-screen burst beam.
